page.title: Roleplay
page.subtitle: Character cards · World books · Corpus import · Prompt preview

overview.usage1: A card is a persona: every card is projected into an AstrBot persona, selectable on any platform (QQ, web chat).
overview.usage2: World books inject by keyword: an entry enters the context only when the chat text matches its keywords, within each book's token budget.
overview.usage3: In QQ chat use /rp /卡 /变体 /块 /世书 /开场 /lore /导入; the dashboard covers the same operations.
overview.usage4: Prompt preview shows the final system prompt and the fired entries before any message is sent.

relay.title: Send to a platform (QQ)
relay.hint: OneBot v11 (NapCat and similar) supports proactive sending; the official QQ API platform does not — use its own push from the platform page.

import.hint: Import reads files that follow the naming rules: files containing 「角色扮演SystemPrompt」 are character cards (the full and condensed variants are detected automatically), files containing 「世界书」 or 「设定集」 are world books. Markdown stays the source of truth; re-importing refreshes text but keeps your block toggles, persona and session bindings.
import.idle: Enter a directory, scan it, then import.

preview.hint: Uses exactly the same assembly path as a real request (persona projection + world book hits).
